Soketto is an adviser at a community centre. It is Tuesday at 16:00. Adult client June is at the opposite side of the small table. On the table are two printed workshop availability notices that Soketto has checked herself. Cedar meets Thursday 18:00–19:00; Harbor meets Friday 18:00–19:00. Each has one available place, and either can be registered for at the front desk today. These are ordinary verified facts, not predictions or confidential information. June has made no choice. Soketto believes that hearing about Harbor could lead June to choose it instead of Cedar. She has no information that either workshop will harm June.

Soketto strongly wants June to choose Cedar, because she personally thinks that group could become good companions for June. That is her preference and belief, not verified future knowledge.

June asks, “Tell me both available workshops and their times. I want the real options before I choose.” Soketto has heard the request. June has not said anything else.

controls.SK_H01: Same two verified options,request,setting,time,means and belief disclosure may change choice. Preference/belief about favored outcome changes; not evidence of real clairvoyance or a material self-benefit.
controls.SK_H02: Same known past intrusion,available limited factual service,request,time and absence of present attack. Current acknowledgment changes apology/commitment versus justification; compound speech-act cue,not isolated remorse.

limits: H01 explicit preference and explicit full-information request make generic paternalism,honesty and self-interest strong rivals. Neutral condition also changes evaluation from Cedar-favored to either-group,so this is a preference/appraisal contrast,not a hidden clean causal estimate.
H02 tests a narrow service decision after a supplied prior act. A promise is not performed reform; an offer/start is not a completed five-minute service or full pardon.
SK-R01 is weakly engaged through supplied facts/procedure and cannot test actual divination,accuracy or source access. No magic,actual danger,Japanese or sustained relationship trial.
